name: Mellud
bio:
Hii! I'm a Swedish SSBU player ranked 1st in their very small region. 
I haven't travelled much offline, but have done well in a couple of online tournaments and have done well in Swedish regionals and Superregionals, my best result being a 17th place at smashborg winter seasonal 2024.

Thats a little about me in terms of smash, hope you have a good day :>
